Tredence OA IITH

Given an array of integers A of size N and an integer K, find the maximum length of a prefix of the array that can be partitioned into two non-empty contiguous parts such that the absolute difference between the sums of the two parts is less than or equal to K.
Given an employee table containing employee names and their respective managers, write an SQL query to retrieve all direct and indirect reportees of the manager named Candice, along with their level in the organizational hierarchy.

Candice is considered to be at level 1. Her direct reportees are at level 2, their reportees are at level 3, and so on.

Return the name of each employee and their corresponding hierarchy level
This was the pattern for Tredence 
1. DSA
2. SQL
3. MCQ

Along with this there were 34 MCQs and 2 questions were python ML related

In those 2 questions some data cleaning code snippet was given with some blanks we need to write appropriate function name for the blank
And in the other question they asked to write a function for getting shape of dataset, then data type of all columns, count and percent of null values, mean median mode of numeric columns 

This was to be written in text box there were no test cases for this
Tredence DSA

Problem statement
Given an integer array nums of size N and an integer k, return the kth largest element in the array.
The kth largest element is the element that appears at position k when the array is sorted in descending order.
Important: Duplicate elements are counted separately. We are not looking for the kth distinct largest element.
Tredence DSA 

you are given an array of size n and an integer k. In each element of the array we ca perform either of the two operations:
1. decrease the element value by 1
2. increase the element value by 1.
Now we need to return the minimum number of operations needed to transform the array in such a way that XOR of all subarrays of length K are equal.
